mapper.update: UPDATE g2b_bid_notice_candidates candidate SET imported_bid_seq = notice.bid_seq FROM bid_notices notice WHERE candidate.bid_ntce_no = notice.g2b_bid_ntce_no AND candidate.bid_ntce_ord = notice.g2b_bid_ntce_ord AND candidate.imported_bid_seq IS DISTINCT FROM notice.bid_seq
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO system_notices ( notice_id, title, content, target_path, exposure_start_at, exposure_end_at, publish_at, important, active, created_at, created_id, last_changed_at, last_changed_id ) SELECT 'G2B-CANDIDATE-' || current_candidate.id, '나라장터 공고 변경 알림', current_candidate.bid_ntce_no || ' 공고가 ' || REPLACE(COALESCE(NULLIF(current_candidate.ntce_kind_nm, ''), '변경공고'), '공고', '') || '되었습니다.', '/pq/g2b-bid-notice-candidates?bidNtceNo=' || current_candidate.bid_ntce_no, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP + INTERVAL '14 days', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, FALSE, TRUE, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'g2b-bid-notice-batch', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'g2b-bid-notice-batch' FROM g2b_bid_notice_candidates current_candidate WHERE current_candidate.imported_bid_seq IS NULL AND current_candidate.last_seen_at >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '1 day' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM g2b_bid_notice_candidates imported_candidate WHERE ( imported_candidate.bid_ntce_no = current_candidate.bid_ntce_no OR imported_candidate.bid_ntce_no = current_candidate.bef_bid_bbanc_no ) AND imported_candidate.imported_bid_seq IS NOT NULL AND imported_candidate.id < current_candidate.id ) AND ( current_candidate.ntce_kind_nm ILIKE '%변경%' OR current_candidate.ntce_kind_nm ILIKE '%취소%' OR current_candidate.ntce_kind_nm ILIKE '%재공고%' ) ON CONFLICT (notice_id) DO NOTHING
